subject: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Fisher <lauren@peak-talent.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

Team —

Quick summary: we pulled together the final runtime/infra slate for Q4 recruiting and there are two items that need sign-off before offers go out this week:

1) Senior Runtime Engineer (candidate J. Patel) — comp band recommendation is $185k base + 20% target IC (band E5-E6 midpoint stretch). Recruit is asking for a payband exception to $200k base to match counter from the candidate's current employer.

2) Platform SRE (backfill) — standard band alignment, no exception required, but we need to confirm headcount unlock from finance to convert contractor -> FTE (effective 12/1).

Attached: HIRE-SLATE-Q4-2026.xlsx (full slate), J-Patel-offer-draft.pdf, payband-exception-request.docx.

Ask: Marissa/Markus/Evelyn — can you confirm (a) approval for a one-time payband exception for J. Patel (final offer not to exceed $200k base), (b) sign-off to convert contractor headcount for Platform SRE and route to finance for funding? If approved, Lauren (recruiter) will finalize verbal offer today and trigger DocuSign.

Quick notes on risk/impact: if we lose J. Patel we will likely push timeline on RT optimizer work by ~6 weeks; candidate is high priority for throughput subsystems.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Principal, Platform Recruiting Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

Priyom — thanks for pulling this together and including the attachments. I reviewed the slate and the business case for J. Patel looks solid. Two quick items:

- On payband: I am ok approving a one-time exception to $200k base for J. Patel provided we (a) set a 12-month comp review (to re-evaluate band), and (b) document the exception in the HR payband exception form (please attach to HIRE-497).
- On Platform SRE conversion: need finance sign-off but I support converting the HC given critical on-call gap. Evelyn — requesting you route to finance for the funding confirmation.

If everyone agrees I will mark the exception approved and loop legal for the final offer language.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

+1 from me. Approval for the $200k one-time exception is fine; please add the following gating conditions to the offer:

- Final sign-off contingent on background + reference checks (standard).
- Candidate to accept within 72 hours of verbal offer or exception lapses.
- If candidate requests additional equity, escalate to me before countering.

Also, Priyom — can you confirm if total OTE changes or if this is base-only bump? I want clarity for forecasting.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

Looping in finance ops (copied below) — I ran a quick headcount check and we have a one-time buffer in Q4 that can cover the Platform SRE conversion for 6 months, after which the team budget must absorb it. I will create the funding request and tag it to HIRE-497; expect a response from finance by EOD tomorrow.

To Karthik: this $200k is base-only (total OTE stays within previously modeled ranges given IC target remains 20%); I will attach the updated comp table to the ticket.

Next steps I will take today:
- Create funding request in Workday (HIRE-497) and attach payband exception doc.
- Add comp table and modeling to the ticket.

Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Fisher <lauren@peak-talent.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

Hi all — I spoke with J. Patel this morning. Candidate is happy to accept a $200k base if we can get verbal approval by end of day today; they would like equity clarified in the offer (asking for 0.25% RSU grant or equivalent). I have prepared the draft offer (attached) and can initiate DocuSign once I get confirmation on the base and equity language.

Attachment: J-Patel-offer-draft.pdf (contains proposed base, IC, and RSU placeholder).

Please confirm so we can move quickly — candidate timeline is tight.

Lauren
Senior Technical Recruiter
Peak Talent (external recruiting partner)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Fisher <lauren@peak-talent.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating Q4 runtime/infra hiring slate — approval & payband alignment

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Approvals are confirmed as follows:

- Payband exception to $200k base for J. Patel — APPROVED (documented in payband-exception-request.docx, attached to HIRE-497).
- Platform SRE conversion funding — Provisionally approved for 6 months; finance to confirm long-term absorption (Evelyn, please escalate if there is any shortfall).

Karthik — please authorize recruiter to include the 0.25% RSU placeholder; final equity will be signed off by comp committee but ok to include as an offer term.

Priyom/Lauren — please proceed with verbal offer and DocuSign. Priyom, mark the thread resolved once DocuSign completes and add final docs to the hiring ticket.

Markus
SVP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
